name: Heart of Atlantis
source:
Since you were young, you’ve always felt as if something was calling you to the sea. Now, as an oceanography student, you come across the discovery of a lifetime with your dark and broodingly handsome professor—the sunken city of Atlantis. But your field study takes an unexpected turn when your submarine crashes and you wake in the arms of a beautiful merman, who’s the crown prince of the lost kingdom.

And that’s not all—you soon discover that you have Atlantean blood flowing through your veins! Learning about your lineage will be one of the many things you do as you unearth the secrets of this lost civilization and deepen your bonds with the prince and your mentor. However, the relationship between your two companions soon goes south, and you have to choose between the life you’ve always known on the surface, and your Atlantean heritage.

Experience the thrill of falling in love in the deep blue, and dive into the depths of this lost world to discover your true destiny!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.atlantisotome]Google Play[/url]]
